templates.htmlContent:
EXPLAINED

Is Intuit Enterprise Suite an ERP?

The short answer, the details, and the questions finance leaders ask most before they switch.

THE SHORT ANSWER

Yes, an AI-native ERP for growing companies

Intuit Enterprise Suite is a unified platform that goes beyond basic accounting, consolidating finances, payroll, payments, workforce, and marketing into one connected system, with AI-driven insights and robust multi-entity management.

What makes it different

UNIFIED PLATFORM

One connected system, not five tools

Consolidates finances, payroll, payments, workforce, and marketing into one platform, reducing manual data entry and cost.

AI-DRIVEN INSIGHTS

Automation and intelligence built in

AI provides proactive automation and insights across accounting, financial planning, and more, so the team moves away from manual workflows.

MULTI-ENTITY MANAGEMENT

Built for multiple entities and subsidiaries

Manage intercompany transactions and generate consolidated reports with a comprehensive view of performance across the business.

Frequently asked questions

What size company is it built for?
Intuit Enterprise Suite is built for businesses with growing financial complexity, especially those managing multiple entities, locations, or projects, that have outgrown QuickBooks Online but are not ready for a traditional ERP.
Is this a cloud version of QuickBooks Desktop?
No. It is a new category of software distinct from QuickBooks Online and Desktop, built for businesses that have outgrown basic accounting and need to scale operations.
How easy is it to migrate?
Whether you migrate from QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, or a non-Intuit solution, a Professional Services team scopes and moves your data and a Customer Success Manager runs guided onboarding.
Is support available?
Yes. Core product support is available Monday through Friday, 6 AM to 6 PM PT, and a dedicated Customer Success Manager is assigned to your account during onboarding.

Still have questions?

Talk to a migration specialist and find out if Intuit Enterprise Suite is the right move for your business.

Schedule a call

A plain-language look at how Intuit Enterprise Suite unifies every entity, eliminates intercompany noise, and closes the books faster.

One platform, every entity, in real time

Growing companies outgrow spreadsheets and disconnected ledgers long before they are ready for a legacy ERP. Intuit Enterprise Suite closes that gap with a single system that manages users, entities, locations, and subsidiaries from one sign-in.

01

Manage every entity, location, and subsidiary from one login without juggling separate files.

02

Automatic eliminations

Intercompany transactions reconcile and eliminate on their own, so consolidated numbers stay clean.

03

Consolidated reporting

Roll up performance across the business into one consolidated view, refreshed in real time.

04

Faster close

Automation trims the month-end close from weeks to days across all entities at once.

A CLOSER LOOK

From rearview reporting to real-time decisions

Instead of stitching numbers together after the fact, finance leaders see the full picture as it happens. The result is fewer surprises, a shorter close, and more time for the analysis that actually moves the business.

HOW IT WORKS

How the AI Finance Agent works

Follow the workflow from raw transactions to a faster, more accurate month-end close, step by step.

Explore agents

Four steps from data to decision

The Accounting Agent and Finance Agent work together across your ledger. Here is what happens at each stage, and what you get back.

  1. 1

    STEP 1

    Capture and clean

    The Accounting Agent updates transactions, combines data from across the business, and flags inconsistencies automatically.

  2. 2

    STEP 2

    Reconcile and categorize

    Bookkeeping tasks that used to take hours are handled in the background, so the ledger stays current.

  3. 3

    STEP 3

    Summarize and monitor

    The Finance Agent delivers monthly financial summaries, budget insights, and ongoing performance monitoring.

  4. 4

    STEP 4

    Close with confidence

    Month-end close arrives faster with accuracy you can count on, freeing the team for higher-value analysis.
